output.summary: System records show Arts is not deprioritised like-for-like. Category- and priority-matched Arts tickets are within 0.3 days of the rest of the university. About 70% of the resolution gap comes from SlotBook tickets, which RR-17 routes to a P4 best-effort queue. These wait a median of 17 days before any technician acts. Most of the rest comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover at Lindqvist, which also affects Education. Duplicate and trivial tickets do not explain the volume. SlotBook explains only part of it, because non-SlotBook volume is still 1.6x average. Whether Arts was told about RR-17 is disputed, and the change record shows no notification. Best next step is an agreed written SlotBook support position, with requesters told the priority. A separate Arts desk or an all-Arts best-effort track is not justified.
